description: TrendChart model: layout, live/paused/review window, autoscale, decimated polylines, cursor readouts, gesture effects, drawing parity.

cases.name: layout: legend right, two equal lanes, one left axis each
window: live, pause, review scroll with clamping, resume
autoscale pads 5%, flat series pad half magnitude, fixed and digital axes stay fixed
readouts take the sample at or before the cursor; deltas between cursors
gestures: pan pauses and clamps, zoom anchors at cursor when paused and at the live edge otherwise
box zoom fixes the lane axis and the time range; reset clears everything
hover and clicks place cursors only inside the plot
moving a series between lanes changes the axis layout
overlay legend sits in the configured corner
digital signals on a shared axis stack like a logic analyzer
custom style and theme are honoured in every op
drawing parity: every op identical in both cores
iba: resizable lanes — dragging the gap moves height between the two lanes; weights keep their sum; each lane keeps 24 px
iba: legend as a control — hidden series stay listed and dimmed, toggle, rename, colour, width, remove
iba: measurements — value at A and B, delta, min, max, mean over the span; cursors drag; the table sits at the bottom of the plot
iba: layout file — export carries the arrangement without theme or style; import replaces it and keeps the theme
iba: logic analyzer — mixed lane: stack at the bottom, analog above, no digital axis; digital drops target stacks, analog never joins one
iba: digital-only lane fills the lane with filled tracks; the legend reads true/false
iba: digital drop — a digital channel dropped into a lane joins its logic stack, or starts one at the bottom of an analog lane
iba: legend groups series by shared axis with a bracket; labels follow the same order
iba: hit test — legend row, header parts, labels, axis zones, plot, time axis, navigator
iba: drop targets — axis strip and labels join that axis, free area gives an own axis, time axis and gaps make lanes
iba: moving one signal — common axis, own axis, new lane; moving back merges; empty lanes vanish
iba: group drops — a group shares one axis in free space, one lane with ctrl, one lane each without; channels become series
iba: lanes — drag the header to reorder (frame index), fold and unfold, remove with its series, hide a series
iba: Y axes — dragging the middle shifts, the ends stretch about the other end, wheel zooms about the pointer, double-click autoscales
iba: navigator — full range, frame, zones, edge and inside drags, click centres, keys step, fixed range, silhouettes
iba: drawing parity with headers, labels, a folded lane, a drag in progress and the navigator
iba: add channels from code or a drop — default lands in the first lane (digital in its stack), explicit targets apply, unknown channels are skipped; drag payload formats
